title: The Fertile field by the river
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：fertile　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fertile 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the headmaster wrote of ① a fertile field by the river in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② so fertile that nobody in the school would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the fertile ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the fertile field by the river that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record for October 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too fertile to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the fertile ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a fertile mind of the writer, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as fertile as the mind of the writer they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was fertile or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something fertile, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite fertile; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the fertile ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another fertile field by the river in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less fertile than anybody had expected. ⑩ The fertile mind of the writer that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the fertile ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 肥沃（前置定语 a fertile field by the river：1977 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件肥沃的田地）
B. adj. 肥沃／丰产（两处加强说法：so fertile that … 与 no less fertile than …）
C. adj. 肥沃／丰产（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 肥沃（表语 too fertile to do：母亲觉得它太肥沃，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 丰产（前置定语 a fertile mind of the writer：叔叔把整件事称作一桩丰产的头脑）
F. adj. 丰产（同级比较 as fertile as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩作家丰产的头脑相比）
G. adj. 丰产（后置定语 something fertile：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 丰产（受程度副词修饰 quite fertile：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a fertile field by the river
the fertile field by the river that
a fertile mind of the writer
The fertile mind of the writer that

answers.why: fertile 意为“肥沃”，1977 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件肥沃的田地”，此处作前置定语 a fertile field by the river。
fertile 意为“肥沃”，此处用 so fertile that 结构，说它肥沃到学堂里没人敢靠近。
fertile 意为“肥沃”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的肥沃河边的田地，等于最高级的说法。
fertile 意为“肥沃”，母亲认为这件东西“太肥沃了，谁也用不上”，too fertile to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
fertile 意为“丰产”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩丰产的头脑”，此处作前置定语 a fertile mind of the writer。
fertile 意为“丰产”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩作家丰产的头脑一样丰产”，同级比较用 as fertile as。
fertile 意为“丰产”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“丰产的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something fertile。
fertile 意为“丰产”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当丰产”，quite 修饰原级 fertile。
fertile 意为“丰产”，no less fertile than 表示“其丰产不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之丰产不亚于任何人的预料。
fertile 意为“丰产”，母亲 1989 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的丰产头脑”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，校长在学籍册里记下了一件肥沃的田地。（a fertile field by the river）
它肥沃到学堂里没有一个人敢靠近。（so fertile that …）
母亲觉得它太肥沃，谁也用不上。（too fertile to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩丰产的头脑。（a fertile mind of the writer）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩作家丰产的头脑一样丰产。（as fertile as …）
到了 1984 年，学籍册上只剩半行字：要的是一件丰产的东西。（something fertile）
answers: In 1977 the headmaster wrote of a fertile field by the river in the record.
It was so fertile that nobody in the school would go near it.
My mother thought it too fertile to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a fertile mind of the writer.
He said nobody would call it as fertile as the mind of the writer they had once had.
By 1984 the record asked for nothing but something fertile.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fertile 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the headmaster wrote of a fertile field by the river in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the fertile field by the river that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too fertile to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a fertile mind of the writer, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next school called the plan quite fertile, and everybody laughed.
The fertile ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
